paper_title: Constraints on the Coupling between Axionlike Dark Matter and Photons Using an Antiproton Superconducting Tuned Detection Circuit in a Cryogenic Penning Trap
notes: BASE Penning-trap haloscope using superconducting LC detection circuit. Constrains ALP-photon coupling g_agamma < 1e-11 GeV^-1 over a narrow mass band 2.7906-2.7914 neV/c^2 (~2.791 neV). Limit value taken from abstract/text; exact data points are in Fig. 3 (not numerically available).
